jobs.title: Senior Manager, FP&A
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE 🌍

Creating content that resonates is great — turning that attention into growth is even better. That's what Manychat does.

Our AI-powered automations help creators and brands engage with audiences across Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp, and TikTok — at the right moment, with the right message, minus the manual work.

We're 400+ people across three continents behind the leading platform for conversational growth, with AI skills shaping how we build, how we work, and how we grow.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR 🌟

We are looking for a Senior Manager of FP&A to join our Finance team. This is a high-impact, hands-on role that owns the full planning cycle, from annual budget to monthly close to cash forecasting, while serving as a strategic finance partner to business leaders. You will bring both technical depth and commercial instincts, and you will thrive in a fast-moving, high-growth environment.

WHAT YOU'LL DO 🚀

 - Co-own the full FP&A cycle: annual budgeting, quarterly reforecasts, monthly close and variance analysis, and rolling forward forecasts across headcount and Opex.

 - Own cash flow forecasting: build and maintain a rolling 12-month cash model using both direct and indirect methods, ensuring the two reconcile and triangulate against each other. Monitor liquidity by building scenario and sensitivity models to surface risks and opportunities to leadership in advance.

 - Partner closely with GTM leaders (Marketing, Customer Success) to build bottoms-up expense models driven by operational KPIs and unit economics ratios, and track performance against plan.

 - Own and standardize our SaaS KPI framework (MRR, GDR, NDR, CAC, LTV, payback period) and translate metrics into actionable insights for the executive team and board.

 - Expand the operational KPI library to include operational efficiency and unit economics metrics across the business, including but not limited to support ticket volume and resolution rate, agent-to-ticket ratios, cost per lead, pipeline conversion rates, and capacity-based cost drivers (e.g. per-seat or per-location spend).

 - Update the LRP using these metrics as dynamic inputs so that changes in business volume, headcount, or cost structure automatically flow through to the forecast and guide business partners toward optimal operational targets.

 - Drive continuous improvement of FP&A processes, tools, and reporting infrastructure.

TO SHINE IN THIS ROLE 💥

You'll need:

 - 7+ years of FP&A experience with Big 4 accounting or investment banking background.

 - Hands-on experience building and maintaining a 12-month rolling cash flow forecast using both the direct method (cash receipts and disbursements) and the indirect method (net income adjusted for non-cash items and working capital changes), with the ability to reconcile and triangulate the two outputs.

 - Deep understanding of SaaS business models, ideally with exposure to product-led growth (PLG); you speak fluently about MRR, ARR, GDR, NDR, logo retention, and cohort analysis.

 - Strong command of GAAP accounting and three-statement modeling; you understand how an operational decision flows through the P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow statement.

 - Demonstrated ability to leverage AI tools to improve productivity, accelerate analysis, and enhance the accuracy of FP&A deliverables.

 - Proven track record owning month-end close, variance analysis, and rolling forecasts in a high-growth environment.

 - Exceptional business partnering skills; you build credibility with non-finance stakeholders across GTM and functional teams and influence decisions without formal authority.

 - Strong communication skills; able to distill complex financial data into clear narratives for leadership and board audiences.

It would be great if you have:

 - Experience at a B2B SaaS company with a self-serve or PLG motion.

 - Pre-IPO start-up experience.

 - Prior experience building or scaling an FP&A function from early stage through growth.

WHAT WE OFFER 🤗

We care deeply about your growth, well-being, and comfort:

 - 📚 Annual professional development reimbursement for conference tickets, online courses, and other relevant resources to help you grow.

 - 💙 Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents.

 - 🪴 Hybrid work and generous leave options to prioritize your work-life balance.

 - 🍽️ In-office perks, including free meals and snacks.

 - 🤝 Company-funded sport activities, annual offsites and team-building events.

Manychat is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We do not discriminate against qualified employees or applicants because of race, color, religion, gender identity, sex, sexual preference, sexual identity, pregnancy, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, marital status, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, military status, or any other characteristic protected by local law or ordinance.

This commitment is also reflected through our candidate experience. If you have individual needs that may require an accommodation during the interview process, please indicate this in your application. We will do our best to provide assistance throughout your interview process to ensure you’re set up for success.

WHO WE ARE 🌍

Creating content that resonates is great. Turning that attention into growth is even better. That’s what Manychat does.

Our AI-powered automations help creators and brands engage with audiences across Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp, and TikTok: at the right moment, with the right message, minus the manual work.

We’re 400+ people across three continents behind the leading platform for conversational growth, with AI skills shaping how we build, how we work, and how we grow.


WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR 🌟

Have you built a sales engine from scratch: defined the motion, hired the first reps, and scaled to something real? If so, this might be the most compelling blank canvas you’ve seen in a while.

Manychat for Brands is a strategic initiative targeting brands and agencies. We’re past the design partner phase and approaching public launch, which means the timing is right to bring in a sales leader who can hit the ground running in Q1.

This is Manychat’s first mid-market sales division. You’ll work with the credibility of a market-leading platform behind you and the freedom of a startup in front of you. The ICP spans growth marketing and influencer marketing leaders at brands, plus agencies: a space primed for conversational automation.

You’re not here to inherit a playbook. You’re here to write one. If that’s the kind of challenge that energizes you, let’s talk.


WHAT YOU’LL DO 🚀

 - Build and own the sales function for Manychat for Brands from the ground up: strategy, process, tooling, and team.

 - Personally close the first few deals while simultaneously laying the infrastructure for scale (player-coach model).

 - Design and run both inbound/inside sales and outbound BDR → AE motions, iterating rapidly to find what works.

 - Define and refine the ICP across brands and agencies; validate and evolve the go-to-market approach in close partnership with marketing and product.

 - Scale the team progressively from a lean starting point to multiple layers of AEs/BDRs as results validate growth.

 - Introduce an AI-stack and modern outbound infrastructure to maximize productivity and pipeline efficiency.

 - Collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, product, operations, and the Customer Success team to deliver a seamless customer journey.

 - Provide feedback on pricing, packaging, and product fit. Your voice in the room matters.

 - Establish clear metrics, forecasting, and reporting rhythms; manage to targets for deals closed and average deal value.


TO SHINE IN THIS ROLE 💥

You’ll need:

 - A zero-to-one mindset with “tech scrappy” energy, ideally forged at a Series A to Series C company.

 - Genuine comfort being hands-on as a player-coach: you close deals yourself while building the team and systems around you.

 - Proven experience leading a B2B sales team from a handful of reps to a full-scale sales org in a mid-market or similar segment.

 - Experience designing and running both inbound/inside and outbound sales motions.

 - Strong cross-functional collaboration skills; you naturally partner with marketing, product, and CS to drive shared outcomes.

It would be great if you have:

 - Familiarity with the modern AI stack for outbound and agentic BDR systems; we value modern approaches over old-school playbooks.

 - Experience selling to brand marketing, growth marketing, or influencer marketing personas, or to agencies.

 - Exposure to product-led growth or self-serve SaaS environments (not required, but helpful context).


WHAT WE OFFER 🤗

We care deeply about your growth, well-being, and comfort. Benefits at Manychat don’t start with a spreadsheet; they start with a belief: that you should be healthy, able to care for the people you love, and set up to do your best work. Everything below follows from that:

 - 📚 Annual professional development budget reimbursement for conference tickets, online courses, and other relevant resources to help you grow.

 - 💙 Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents.

 - 🪴Hybrid work and generous,and flexible time off

 - 🍽️ In-office perks, including free meals and snacks.

 - 🤝 Company-funded sport activities, annual offsites and team-building events.

 - 🤖 AI isn’t a perk here; it’s how we work. Tools like Claude and OpenAI are available by default, and we genuinely back teams in adopting whatever makes them faster. It’s a toolkit that’s well ahead of the market, and you’ll have it from day one.

Visa sponsorship for this role is currently not available.

For New York City-based hires only: Compensation Range: $220–$240K base salary, subject to standard withholding and applicable taxes. In addition to base salary, the role includes opportunity to receive and/or earn a discretionary bonus and/or equity based on Company’s plans and in accordance with Company’s policies. Compensation finally awarded to the candidate will be commensurate with the candidate’s skills and experience. jobs.title: Head of People Operations
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE 🌍

Creating content that resonates is great — turning that attention into growth is even better. That's what Manychat does.

Our AI-powered automations help creators and brands engage with audiences across Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp, and TikTok — at the right moment, with the right message, minus the manual work.

We're 400+ people across three continents behind the leading platform for conversational growth, with AI skills shaping how we build, how we work, and how we grow.


WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR 🌟

We are looking for a Head of People Operations to build and run a distributed hub model that delivers an excellent people experience — in every location, every day.

Your job is not to design the system from scratch. It's to own the execution of it across six hubs: hold the standard, make local teams genuinely strong, and build the kind of autonomy where hub partners decide and act without waiting.

This is not a classic HR Operations leadership role. What distinguishes it:

 - You lead distributed hub teams that own the full employee lifecycle on the ground — not a central function serving locations from a distance

 - You build autonomy, not dependency — hub teams should know what winning looks like and act on it

 - You partner directly with the individual domain leads across the function — Workplace & Experience, Payroll, Compliance, People Tech, Rewards. Not their manager, but a peer who depends on their expertise to run the hubs well

 - AI is core infrastructure, not a pilot — you default to automation for everything repeatable in the function

You thrive in ambiguity, move fast, and think in systems. You have the operational depth to manage complex multi-country employment realities, and the leadership to develop hub teams that genuinely own their work.


WHAT YOU'LL DO 🚀

Lead the Hub Model

 - Own People Operations across all hubs: Netherlands, Spain, Armenia, US (Austin, Bay Area, New York), Brazil, Remote

 - Each hub team covers the full employee lifecycle in location — pre-boarding, onboarding, changes, exits — with local office and facilities support, and local events and team-building

 - Set the standard for what excellent hub execution looks like, and hold it across all locations

 - Run the weekly sync rhythm with each hub — align priorities, surface blockers, keep quality consistent

 - Build the hub community: connect People Ops partners across locations to share practice and raise the floor

Own Outcomes, Not Process

 - Hub teams should decide and act — your job is to remove blockers, not add approval layers

 - Own the OKR cascade: every hub has OKRs that roll up through the function; you're accountable for making that cascade real, not formal

 - Define what success looks like in each location — local service standards, local processes, local roadmap

Partner with Domain Leads

Clear interfaces are the model, not the exception:

 - Workplace & Experience — deploy global programs and standards locally; coordinate on facilities, office improvements, and events beyond the local scope

 - Payroll — ensure multi-country payroll accuracy and surface local issues early

 - People Tech — maintain HRIS data quality and drive system adoption across hubs

 - Compliance — support policy adoption, manager training, and exit case handling in every location

 - Rewards — run compensation reviews and benefits implementation per country

Challenge feasibility, propose alternatives, execute agreed decisions.

Build the Team

 - Manage People Operations Partners across locations: NL, ES, AM, BR, US, Remote

 - You're standing up the hub model while running it — build the team while it's operating

 - Drive team development: upgrade skills, address underperformance, enable people with AI tools

 - Build hub teams that operate autonomously — no daily hand-holding required

Manage the Operational Realities

 - Visa and relocation support coordination across locations

 - Local compliance and employment framework adherence, in partnership with Compliance

 - Office and facilities baseline across hub locations — in coordination with Workplace & Experience on standards

Build AI-Native Operations

 - Default to automation for employee queries, document generation, onboarding workflows, and operational logistics

 - Build self-service so people don't need to contact us for anything a good system can answer

 - Treat AI adoption within the function as infrastructure and a performance metric

 


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE 🎯

 - Hub teams operating autonomously across all locations — you're steering, not executing day-to-day

 - Every hub has OKRs, knows what winning looks like, and can tell if they hit it

 - Employee lifecycle is consistent and increasingly automated across all locations

 - Cross-functional interfaces with Payroll, Tech, Compliance, W&E are clean and frictionless

 - Knowledge base live and current in a single source of truth

 - AI and automation handle the majority of repeatable operational tasks inside the function

 - Every hub partner owns their roadmap — not just their to-do list


TO SHINE IN THIS ROLE 💥

Experience & Background

 - 10+ years in People Operations, HR Operations, or Operations leadership in multinational environments

 - Direct experience managing distributed teams across multiple countries and employment frameworks

 - Proven record building distributed operating models — not just inheriting and running existing ones

 - Experience standing up new processes and functions in fast-changing environments

 - Strong change management experience — organizational transitions handled with operational rigor and human care

 - Experience in fast-scaling tech environments — SaaS and start-up / scale-up required

Skills & Mindset

 - Systems thinker: you see how processes connect, where the friction is, and what the fix is

 - AI-native operating instinct: you treat every new process as a question of which system or agent should own it

 - Comfortable with ambiguity: non-linear situations with predictable outcomes

 - Stakeholder management: you go and solve, not email and wait

 - Cross-cultural judgment: you understand employment realities across NL, ES, BR, AM, US — or learn fast when you don't

 - Executive presence: you partner with senior leadership and personally own the hardest operational calls


WHAT WE OFFER 🤗

Benefits at Manychat don't start with a spreadsheet — they start with a belief: that you should be healthy, able to care for the people you love, and set up to do your best work. Everything below follows from that:

 - 🌍 Hybrid onboarding to start work remotely and relocation support for you and your family

 - 💙 Comprehensive health insurance for both you and your family

 - 📚 Professional development budget for conference tickets, online courses, and other relevant resources to help you grow

 - 🫶 Flexible benefits package: instead of a fixed set of perks, you get a flexible benefits budget you can direct across the things that matter most — health, wellbeing, family, and your home office among them. Within these areas, the choice is yours.

 - 🪴 Hybrid work and generous, flexible time off — planned with your team, not rationed by a rigid quota

 - 🌎 Work from where you need to — agreed with your team, not tied to a desk. Flexibility we built in on purpose, because location shouldn't get in the way of great work.

 - 🍽️ In-office perks, including free meals and snacks

 - 🤝 Company-funded sport activities, annual offsites and team-building events

 - 🤖 AI isn't a perk here — it's how we work. Tools like Claude and OpenAI are available by default, and we genuinely back teams in adopting whatever makes them faster. It's a toolkit that's well ahead of the market, and you'll have it from day one.

jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE 🌍

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

You’ll be our first B2B marketing hire, at a company that’s already rocking it. An established brand, massive global exposure, and talent for days to help you do great things.


We’re looking for someone who’s built brands, created demand, and filled pipelines before. Someone with a point of view on how these things should work, and the ability to get them working.


You’ll shape the strategy, launch some programs, and build a star-studded team to take our new product to the…um, stars? We might also need a copywriter.



YOUR FUTURE TEAMMATES

First of all, you’ll be part of the dashing new super unit currently known as ‘Manychat for Brands’. You’ll partner with a new product team, a new customer success team, a new sales team… there’s a pattern here we can’t fully put our finger on.


And of course, the Manychat Marketing team. You’re part of that too.


These people are the worst. Chaotic, opinionated, and just plain weird. You will love us to death.



WHY YOU'LL LIKE IT HERE

How awesome is it to build something from scratch, but this time with resources! and knowledge! and a universally loved brand behind you! The opportunity of a lifetime.


You’ll have the freedom to try things, the support to make them happen, and the responsibility to figure out whether they worked. Your ideas will also meet customers. They will decide everything. They are your new boss.


Oh and you get to build your own super team? Pinch yourself to find out if this is a real JD.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build the brand foundations

 - Build scalable growth systems (legal made us write ‘scalable’ at least once)

 - Create demand and grow pipeline

 - Mine the Manychat ecosystem for opportunities

 - Help Sales win

 - Build a team worthy of Manychat

 - Talk about horses unusually often

 - More things.
   


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - If you don’t know this, please do not apply.

 - Just kidding.

 - Or are we?

 - Note from Legal: We are.
   


TO SHINE IN THIS ROLE

 - You’ll want to have experience building and scaling B2B marketing teams that were very proud of what they’ve done at the time. Their CEO was also proud of them because it made them rich.

 - Experience with brand AND demand! We’re in a why-not-both situation here.

 - Also product marketing! Yeesh, starting to seem unreasonably ambitious with the requirements here.

 - You are unreasonably ambitious, yes?

 - Also - be kind always. We’re very touchy about this one.
